unknownPromptTrustedAllowChangedRevokedR.implementation: TrustPolicy.decide switches over TrustPolicyState: unknown -> prompt; trusted with equal bytes -> allow, otherwise reject(identityChanged); revoked -> reject(identityRevoked)

decisionIsATestablePureFunction.implementation: Caseless enum TrustPolicy with one static function; no stored state, clock, randomness, global mutable state or I/O

noAutoAccept.implementation: allow only from a trusted state with valid equal fingerprints; wrong-length stored or presented data rejects trustRejected before comparison; prompt is not acceptance and nothing is learned between calls
